So, if I quit now, the company might be short-handed, especially since my boss will be on leave and the other manager's position is vacant. I've been slowly looking for a new job for a while, but I'm not sure if I'll have a new position by the time my boss is in her third trimester. Part of me wants to quit now to avoid any awkwardness or resentment that might come if I leave later. But I'm also considering my obligations to my current employer.
